name: Accordion
description: A stacked disclosure list where each panel expands in place, optionally one at a time.
whenToUse: FAQs, pricing detail, spec tables, 'how it works' steps — anywhere the user asks for an accordion, a collapsible list, expandable Q&A, or a show/hide list. USE THIS INSTEAD OF WRITING ONE WITH useState: it is built on native <details>, so it publishes with ZERO JavaScript, keeps keyboard and screen-reader behaviour for free, and works with JS disabled. Set `exclusive` for one-panel-at-a-time. NOT for tabbed content shown side by side (that needs a real tab strip), and not for hiding anything expensive — <details> panels are always in the DOM.
